lines.en: Jack and the Beanstalk (
Once there was a young man named Jack.
lines.zh: 从前有个年轻人，名叫杰克。

lines.en: He lived with his mother on a small farm at the foot of the Foggy Mountains.
lines.zh: 他和妈妈住在雾山脚下的一个小农场里。

lines.en: Jack and his mother were very poor.
Their only way of making money was selling the milk from their cow, Bess.
lines.zh: 他们唯一的收入，是卖掉自家那头叫贝丝的奶牛的牛奶。

lines.en: One morning, Jack's mother woke him up early.
lines.zh: 一天清晨，妈妈早早把杰克叫醒。

lines.en: It was still dark outside.
She was crying.
"Jack, wake up!
Go to the market today and sell our cow, Bess."
lines.zh: 今天去集市把我们的牛贝丝卖了吧。”

lines.en: "But why?"
asked Jack, yawning.
"We need money to fix our house.
There are holes in the roof.
The windows are broken.
For heaven's sake, we have no front door.
lines.zh: 天哪，我们连大门都没有。

lines.en: Winter is coming soon.
If we don't fix the house, the cold will kill us!"
lines.zh: 再不修房子，我们会冻死的！”

lines.en: Jack packed his bag and fetched Bess from the barn.
lines.zh: 杰克收拾好包，从牛棚里牵出贝丝。

lines.en: As he was walking out the gate, he heard his mother shout: "She is worth at least five gold coins!
lines.zh: 他走出大门时，听见妈妈喊：“她至少值五个金币！

lines.en: Don’t sell her for less!"
When Jack was half way to the market, he met an old man.
lines.zh: 走到半路，杰克遇见了一位老人。

lines.en: "Good morning, my boy!"
said the old man.
"Where are you going today?"
"Good morning, sir," replied Jack.
"I'm going to the market to sell my cow.
Her name is Bess."
"She is a beautiful cow," said the man.
"I will buy Bess, and I will give you a very good deal!"
lines.zh: “我要买下贝丝，而且我会给你一个很划算的价钱！”

lines.en: “How much will you pay for her?
I won’t take less than five gold coins!
lines.zh: 少于五个金币我可不卖！

lines.en: ” said Jack.
“I don't have five gold coins," whispered the man.
lines.zh: “我没有五个金币，”那人低声说。

lines.en: "But I have these five black beans!
These beans are magic beans!
They are worth more than gold!
If you take these beans, you will be richer than the richest man in the world.
lines.zh: 你收下这些豆子，就会比世界上最富有的人还富有。

lines.en: ” Jack thought about his mother.
He thought about how happy she would be if they were rich.
lines.zh: 他想，如果他们有钱了，妈妈会有多高兴。

lines.en: They could fix the roof, the windows, and the front door.
lines.zh: 他们就能修好屋顶、窗户和大门。

lines.en: Maybe they could buy a new cow!
lines.zh: 说不定还能买一头新奶牛！

lines.en: “Okay," said Jack.
"You’ve got a deal.
Give me the beans!"
Jack was very excited.
He ran home and showed his mother the beans.
lines.zh: 他跑回家，把豆子拿给妈妈看。

lines.en: But instead of being happy, she was furious.
lines.zh: 可妈妈不但没高兴，反而气坏了。

lines.en: “You foolish boy!
You traded our only cow for a handful of beans?!
lines.zh: 你用我们唯一的牛换了一把豆子？！

lines.en: ” She took the beans and threw them out the window.
Then she sat down beside the fire and cried.
lines.zh: 然后她坐在炉火边哭了起来。

lines.en: Jack was devastated.
He shut himself in his bedroom.
He felt so stupid.
They no longer had a cow, and now they were poorer than before.
lines.zh: 他们没有了牛，现在比以前更穷了。

lines.en: What a disaster!
And it was his fault!
The next morning when Jack opened the curtains, he saw something very strange.
lines.zh: 第二天早上，杰克拉开窗帘，看见了一件非常奇怪的事。

lines.en: In the same place where his mother had thrown the beans, there was a giant, green beanstalk.
lines.zh: 就在妈妈扔豆子的那个地方，长出了一根巨大的绿色豆茎。

lines.en: It stretched from the ground, up, up, up… all the way to the clouds.
lines.zh: 它从地面往上、往上、往上……一直长到云里。

lines.en: “The beans really are magic!
” whispered Jack.
"The old man was telling the truth!"
Jack's mother was still asleep, so Jack decided to climb the beanstalk to look for the riches the old man had described.
lines.zh: 妈妈还在睡觉，于是杰克决定爬上豆茎，去找老人说的那些财宝。

lines.en: "Just five gold coins," thought Jack.
That's all I need to make my mother happy."
lines.zh: 这些就够让妈妈高兴了。”

lines.en: Jack climbed up, up, up, higher and higher into the clouds.
lines.zh: 杰克往上爬、往上爬，越爬越高，爬进了云里。

lines.en: When he reached the top, he was very hungry.
He saw a castle in the distance.
lines.zh: 他看见远处有一座城堡。

lines.en: "Maybe I can find something to eat in that castle…" he thought.
lines.zh: “也许我能在那座城堡里找点吃的……”他想。

lines.en: Jack walked up to the door of the castle and knocked twice.
lines.zh: 杰克走到城堡门前，敲了两下。

lines.en: Knock knock!
A giantess opened the door.
lines.zh: 开门的是一个巨人太太。

lines.en: She was as big as a house, but she had a warm smile and gentle eyes.
lines.zh: 她像房子一样高大，却有着温暖的笑容和温和的眼神。

lines.en: "Excuse me, Mrs.
Giant," said Jack.
"Could you please give me something to eat?
I am so hungry!"
"Oh you poor boy!"
said the giantess.
She could see that Jack was very thin.
"Of course!
Come in!
Come in!"
The kind giantess gave Jack some vegetable stew.
lines.zh: 好心的巨人太太给了杰克一些蔬菜炖菜。

lines.en: He was enjoying it so much that he didn't notice when the kitchen table started to shake.
lines.zh: 他吃得太香了，连厨房的桌子开始晃动都没注意到。

lines.en: Stomp...
Stomp...
Stomp… Loud footsteps echoed down the hallway.
lines.zh: 咚……走廊里传来响亮的脚步声。

lines.en: "Oh dear," whispered the giantess.
"That is my husband!
He is home from work!
He doesn't like humans!
Quick!
Hide!"
Jack hid in the pantry.
The giant stomped into the kitchen and sniffed the air.
lines.zh: 巨人咚咚地走进厨房，嗅了嗅空气。

lines.en: "FEE FI FO FUM!
Hello my beautiful wife!
Wait!
Do I smell a human man?
YUCK!
WHERE IS HE?"
"Good evening, my darling husband," replied the giantess.
lines.zh: “晚上好，我亲爱的丈夫，”巨人太太回答。

lines.en: "There is nobody here.
You smell the vegetable stew, nothing more."
lines.zh: 你闻到的是蔬菜炖菜，没别的。”

lines.en: "Good," grunted the giant.
"I hate humans."
He sat down at the table in the kitchen.
The giant took out a small sack of gold coins out of his pocket and counted them.
lines.zh: 巨人从口袋里掏出一小袋金币，数了起来。

lines.en: One...
two...
three...
four...
five gold coins.
Jack watched from inside the pantry.
"Five gold coins!"
thought Jack.
"If I had that money, I could fix our house!"
lines.zh: “要是我有那笔钱，就能修好我们的房子了！”

lines.en: When the two giants left the room, Jack stole the five gold coins and slipped them into his bag.
lines.zh: 等两个巨人离开房间，杰克偷走了那五个金币，塞进自己的包里。

lines.en: "This is all I need!"
thought Jack.
But then Jack remembered that his family no longer had a cow.
lines.zh: 可这时杰克想起，家里已经没有牛了。

lines.en: Without a cow, they would surely starve.
lines.zh: 没有牛，他们肯定会饿死。

lines.en: He decided to stay and look for other treasures.
lines.zh: 他决定留下来，再找找别的宝贝。

lines.en: He followed the giant into the living room and hid under the couch.
lines.zh: 他跟着巨人进了客厅，躲在沙发底下。

lines.en: The giant went to the cupboard and pulled out a golden hen.
lines.zh: 巨人走到柜子前，拿出一只金色的母鸡。

lines.en: “Hello, my beautiful hen!
Lay, please!"
said the giant, and the hen laid a golden egg.
lines.zh: 巨人说，母鸡就下了一个金蛋。

lines.en: Jack watched from under the couch.
"A hen that lays golden eggs!"
whispered Jack.
"If I had that hen, I could buy FIFTY cows!"
lines.zh: “要是我有那只母鸡，就能买五十头牛！”

lines.en: When the giant left the room, Jack crawled out from under the couch.
lines.zh: 巨人离开房间后，杰克从沙发底下爬了出来。

lines.en: He went to the cupboard, took the hen, and put it in his bag.
lines.zh: 他走到柜子前，拿起母鸡放进了包里。

lines.en: "This is all I need… " thought Jack.
But then Jack thought about what the old man had promised.
lines.zh: 可接着杰克想起了老人的承诺。

lines.en: Jack imagined being richer than the richest man in the world.
lines.zh: 他想象自己比世界上最富有的人还富有。

lines.en: He decided to see what other treasures he could find.
lines.zh: 他决定再去看看还能找到什么宝贝。

lines.en: He followed the giant into the bedroom, and hid under the bed.
lines.zh: 他跟着巨人进了卧室，躲在床底下。

lines.en: There was a golden harp standing in a corner of the room.
lines.zh: 房间角落里立着一把金色的竖琴。

lines.en: "Hello, my beautiful harp.
Play, please!"
said the giant.
The harp began playing music with no one touching the strings.
lines.zh: 竖琴没人拨弦，自己奏起了音乐。

lines.en: "Wow!
A magic harp!"
whispered Jack.
"That harp would make me rich and famous!"
lines.zh: “有了那把竖琴，我又能发财又能出名！”

lines.en: When the giant fell asleep, Jack crawled out from under the bed.
lines.zh: 巨人睡着后，杰克从床底下爬了出来。

lines.en: He took the magic harp and put it in his bag.
lines.zh: 他拿起魔法竖琴，放进了包里。

lines.en: But this time Jack was less lucky.
lines.zh: 可这一次杰克没那么走运。

lines.en: The magic harp screamed, “Help me, master!
lines.zh: 魔法竖琴尖叫起来：“救命啊，主人！

lines.en: A human is stealing me!
” The giant woke up and saw Jack with the magic harp, the golden hen, and his gold coins.
lines.zh: ”巨人惊醒过来，看见杰克拿着魔法竖琴、金色母鸡，还有他的金币。

lines.en: "STOP, THIEF!"
The giant chased Jack — — out of the bedroom, down the hallway, through the kitchen, and out the front door.
lines.zh: 巨人追着杰克——冲出卧室，穿过走廊，跑过厨房，追出大门。

lines.en: But Jack was smaller and faster than the giant.
lines.zh: 可杰克比巨人个子小、跑得快。

lines.en: Jack reached the beanstalk first and slid down.
lines.zh: 杰克先跑到豆茎那里，滑了下去。

lines.en: He arrived at the ground with all his treasures.
lines.zh: 他带着所有宝贝回到了地面。

lines.en: The giant reached the top of the beanstalk and looked down.
lines.zh: 巨人追到豆茎顶上，往下看。

lines.en: He was afraid of heights.
He slowly climbed down.
"BE CAREFUL, MY HUSBAND!"
shouted the giantess from the castle.
lines.zh: 巨人太太在城堡里喊道。

lines.en: "HUMANS CAN BE DANGEROUS!"
Jack saw the giant coming down the beanstalk.
lines.zh: 杰克看见巨人正顺着豆茎爬下来。

lines.en: So he ran into his house and grabbed an axe.
lines.zh: 于是他跑进屋，抓起一把斧头。

lines.en: He chopped the beanstalk.
Whack!
Whack!
Whack!
Suddenly, the beanstalk snapped.
The giant came tumbling down from the sky.
lines.zh: 巨人从天上翻滚着摔了下来。

lines.en: He fell down, down, down, and landed far away, on the other side of the Foggy Mountains.
lines.zh: 他往下、往下、往下掉，最后落在很远的地方，雾山的另一边。

lines.en: Thud!
For a moment everything was silent.
lines.zh: 有那么一会儿，一切都很安静。

lines.en: Then Jack heard a strange sound from far away.
lines.zh: 接着杰克听见远处传来一个奇怪的声音。

lines.en: "NOOOOOOOOOOOOOooooooooooo!"
It was the giant.
The beanstalk had fallen, and now he had no way to get back up to his castle in the clouds.
lines.zh: 豆茎倒了，他再也回不去云里的城堡了。

lines.en: The giant yelled so loudly that the clouds shook and turned gray.
lines.zh: 巨人吼得那么响，连云都震动起来，变成了灰色。

lines.en: Then somewhere up in the sky, Jack heard Mrs.
lines.zh: 接着，杰克听见天上某个地方，巨人

lines.en: Giant start to cry.
Her tears fell through the clouds in tiny drops and soaked the earth.
lines.zh: 她的眼泪化作小雨滴穿过云层，打湿了大地。

lines.en: After that, Jack and his mother lived a very comfortable life.
lines.zh: 从那以后，杰克和妈妈过上了非常舒适的生活。

lines.en: The golden hen made a Jack a millionaire.
lines.zh: 金母鸡让杰克成了百万富翁。

lines.en: The magic harp made him famous.
Jack married a rich and famous woman and together they had ten children.
lines.zh: 杰克娶了一位富有又出名的妻子，两人一共生了十个孩子。

lines.en: But Jack was never truly happy.
lines.zh: 可杰克从来没有真正快乐过。

lines.en: Every time the wind blew, Jack heard the giant calling for his wife.
lines.zh: 每次刮风，杰克都听见巨人在呼唤他的妻子。

lines.en: And every time it rained, he felt the giant-wife's tears falling on him.
lines.zh: 每次下雨，他都感觉到巨人太太的眼泪落在自己身上。

lines.en: Jack felt sad and guilty.
One day, when Jack was very old, he decided that he didn't want to be sad any more.
lines.zh: 有一天，杰克已经很老了，他决定不再这样伤心下去。

lines.en: He opened a box on his mantelpiece and pulled out one last shrivelled magic bean.
lines.zh: 他打开壁炉架上的盒子，拿出最后一颗干瘪的魔豆。

lines.en: If he could find the giant, he could grow another beanstalk.
lines.zh: 要是能找到巨人，他就能再种一根豆茎。

lines.en: Then the giant could climb back up to his castle in the clouds.
lines.zh: 那样巨人就能爬回云里的城堡。

lines.en: If he could find the giant, he could also apologize for being so greedy.
lines.zh: 要是能找到巨人，他也能为自己当初的贪婪道歉。

lines.en: Jack packed his bag and walked into the Misty Mountains.
lines.zh: 杰克收拾好行囊，走进了雾蒙蒙的山里。

lines.en: Did Jack find the giant?
Did he grow a new beanstalk with the last magic bean?
lines.zh: 他用最后那颗魔豆种出新的豆茎了吗？

lines.en: Nobody knows.
But people say, if you listen closely during a thunderstorm, you can hear the rumbling sound of two giants dancing together in the clouds.
lines.zh: 可人们说，如果你在雷雨时仔细听，能听见云里两个巨人一起跳舞的隆隆声。
